segment_summary: প্রবাসের নতুন পরিবেশ এই স্বাদকে গ্রহণ করে, কিন্তু তা গ্রহণ করার প্রক্রিয়ায় এক গভীর প্রত্যাখ্যানের সুর লুকিয়ে থাকে।

segment_enrichment.angle: Framing the entire conflict not on taste/texture loss, but on a perceived ontological slippage: Is the modern iteration of the food item less 'real' than the memory?
segment_enrichment.story_option: Setting: A sterile airport lounge overlooking unknown transit hubs; Desire: To find one single, untouched clove of familiar spice packet on the tray table; Obstacle: The hum of automated announcements erasing all geographical markers.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Focusing entirely on the ethical dilemma of authenticity: Is it wrong to claim a familiar name for something fundamentally transformed?
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The visual contrast between the deep, saturated ochre of remembered filling and the paler, washed-out hue of its contemporary counterpart.
segment_enrichment.research_question: How does the concept of 'perfect heat' (আঁচ) translate when using different electrical or gas heating systems abroad, impacting textural integrity?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: An external, observed narrative focusing on a shop owner who understands this conflict through commercial transactions.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: This chapter deepens the philosophical rift begun in earlier pieces by moving from mere description of taste loss to an inquiry into ontological status, a shift away from simple geographical displacement.
